# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest release on `main` for the actively maintained Minecraft versions in this repository (`1.20.1` and `1.21.1`).

Older tagged releases may not receive backports.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security issues privately through
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/MeherBenSalem/better_farming_plus/security/advisories/new).

Do not open a public issue or pull request that includes a working exploit before maintainers have had a chance to investigate and prepare a fix.

Include:

- Affected Minecraft / loader version (`1.20.1` Forge or `1.21.1` NeoForge)
- Mod version
- Steps to reproduce
- Impact assessment if known

You should receive an acknowledgment after the report is reviewed. Please allow reasonable time for investigation before any public disclosure.
